forkee.name: web-ocean
forkee.description: Real-time WebGPU ocean renderer written from scratch, no engine. FFT waves, whitecaps, sun glitter, physically based sunset sky with clouds, free camera. Built with Claude Code (Opus 5.5). Opens from a single 61 KB HTML file in Chrome.
